description: A resource fork with a valid header whose resource map points its type list past the end of the map
notes: rsrc-named-resources.bin with the map's type-list offset raised from 28 to 102, which is the map's own length. Expected: ErrorKind::BadOffset. The header agrees with the buffer, so the sniff accepts it as a resource fork and the error comes from the map instead - which is the distinction rsrc-map-past-end.bin exists to contrast with. The type list opens with a two-byte count, so an offset that leaves fewer than two bytes of map is rejected before any type entry is read.
